# T-2: Resolve explicit runtime-log targets

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Bind each read to one matching active or preparing flow authority and block access to unrelated target logs.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Local target mismatches use the shared mismatch envelope.
- Exact active/preparing selection never falls back.
- Missing and ambiguous targets return structured not-found.
- Selected blocks belong to the resolved target run ID.

## Implementation Notes
Add an opt-in preparing-target resolution path rather than changing default behavior for all commands. Reuse `FlowTargetExpectation`; introduce a class only if a new constrained target value is needed.

## Test Strategy
Use spec-local tests with isolated temporary repositories containing multiple active/preparing states and shared no-flow log blocks; cover every identity mismatch and missing-target branch. Every file must begin with a `// spec: R<N> ...` header covering its requirements.
